Not Unity/Apple Player/runtime/performance/M08/human acceptance.

managedCacheRepair.policy: Fresh managed provenance may prove a unique changed graph or an unchanged Bee cache chain bound exactly to fresh Player path/hash/size; cache proof never claims fresh Csc execution.

managedResponseScopeRepair.policy: Cached response stability follows exactly each selected required compiler action's recursive response closure; unrelated DAG responses remain audit-only.

reproductionToolingRepair.policy: Separate protected reproduction behavior authority from candidate-authenticated validation tooling and bind fresh reproduction receipts to that tooling identity.

reproductionToolingCompatibilityRepair.policy: Authenticate nine tooling replacements plus deletion of obsolete H1ManagedSourceProvenanceTests.cs and its .meta; audit assembled Editor source compatibility before build acceptance.

m07FixedBootstrapRepair.policy: Keep BootstrapIsolationRule and FixedAssemblyBytes fail-closed; declare only the two target-qualified representations of the exact reviewed H1 fixed-byte callsite.

m07PostValidationAuthorityRepair.failure: Real ValidateCompilerInputs legitimately mutated the M07 bootstrap scene and AssemblyShadow settings, after which both controlled and normal workflows failed because the full demo-source verifier compared those intentional workflow bytes to the source-anchor blobs.
m07PostValidationAuthorityRepair.policy: Do not weaken the global verifier. During the outer M07 wrapper lifetime only, pre-mutation checks remain the full generic verifier. After a required workflow-owned mutation, each repeated guard requires both the generic installed-runtime/native/package proof with demo-source skipped and a separate M07 demo authority proof that byte-verifies every non-mutable demo build input, authenticates the saved originals of the exact three mutable paths to source-anchor Git blobs, and requires both baseline-bound mutable files to differ from their originals and contain the requested baseline ID. Partial mutation, wrong baseline, backup tamper, immutable-source tamper, untracked code, or caller-requested demo skip all fail closed.
m07PostValidationAuthorityRepair.controlledExpectedFailure: Controlled M07 failure after successful ValidateCompilerInputs for exact-byte restoration verification.

m07GeneratedPlayerInputRecovery.failure: Native-ON Player generation rewrote tracked Assets/HybridCLRGenerate/link.xml, causing the next full source guard to fail after an otherwise successful Player build.
m07GeneratedPlayerInputRecovery.policy: Keep the outer three-path M07 authority unchanged. The normal M07 core snapshots the exact tracked link.xml before each owned Player stage, preserves generated bytes, restores the original bytes after the owned Unity process exits on success or failure, emits a restoration receipt, and only then runs the unchanged full pinned-input guard.

candidateAuthorityAdvance.policy: Advance authority to the last reviewed build-input commit only.
